page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a dense storage-optimized virtual machine instance running on a KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated x86_64 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. The system includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a standard 4.0 GB memory allocation per vCPU core. Networking capabilities feature a baseline network bandwidth of 10 Gbps.

The defining physical characteristic of the ecs.d1.8xlarge is its bundled local storage array, offering 94,489 GB of local HDD capacity. Unlike instances reliant exclusively on network-attached block storage or NVMe SSDs, this massive local disk footprint delivers extremely high raw capacity per instance node at a favorable cost per gigabyte. However, because the primary storage medium consists of mechanical Hard Disk Drives (HDDs) rather than solid-state drives, read and write latencies are substantially higher, and random IOPS performance is limited compared to flash-based alternatives.

Given its specific combination of 32 dedicated vCPUs, 128 GB of RAM, 10 Gbps network bandwidth, and near 95 TB of local hard disk storage, the ecs.d1.8xlarge is structured for storage-dense, sequentially oriented workloads. Typical target deployment scenarios include distributed big data file systems such as Apache Hadoop, log analytics repositories, cold storage indexing systems, and high-capacity batch data processing pipelines where raw disk capacity and sequential throughput take precedence over low-latency random disk access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.d1.8xlarge is a dense storage-oriented virtual machine instance built on a KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 32 dedicated Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 vCPUs running at 2.5 GHz on an x86_64 architecture, paired with 128.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (4.0 GB per core). The instance is equipped with a 10 Gbps baseline network interface and includes a local HDD storage capacity of 94,489 GB. The reliance on mechanical hard disks provides high storage density and cost efficiency for large data volumes, though with higher access latencies than solid-state media. The configuration contains no discrete GPUs and zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The ecs.d1.8xlarge is designed for sequential processing and high-capacity data storage workloads, such as distributed file systems, big data analytics frameworks like Hadoop, and large-scale log archives.
